description: One long room, eleven glass cases down the middle, and every case is immaculate: the glass cleaned, the cloth brushed, the objects raised on little stands he cut himself. A washing machine drum. A television. Nine bottle tops on a card. A tray of coins. A wall panel headed THE HANDOFF: A CHRONOLOGY, in his handwriting, forty lines long, extremely confident. Almost none of it is correct, and it is laid out with such care that people read the whole thing.

window.description: Two tall windows either side of the door, shuttered on the inside to about two-thirds because daylight is what fades a label, so the room gets a band of light at the top and the cases get none of it.
window.name: the shuttered lights
